findings.issue: Infinitive of turn (H6437) plus the noun morning is rendered as a second return, with de mañana as in the morning, so the sea returns in the morning.
H386 is an adjective with a 3ms suffix (strong/permanent/ever-flowing); corriente resolves it as the noun current.

notes: Moisés, Jehová, Egipto, the 3ms verbs, plural huyentes, and en medio del mar match the tokens.
